[@XYDP_RecalcMonsterAbsorb]
#IF
#ACT
MOV N$XY_MDA_Raw 0
MOV N$XY_MDA_CapBonus 0
MOV N$XY_MDA_Cap 60
MOV N$XY_MDA_Final 0
; XYDP-EXTENSION-BEGIN EQUIP_MONSTER_ABSORB
; XY_EQUIP_MAKER_MONSTER_ABSORB_ANCHOR
; XYDP-EXTENSION-END EQUIP_MONSTER_ABSORB
; XYDP-EXTENSION-BEGIN EQUIP_MONSTER_ABSORB_CAP
; XY_EQUIP_MAKER_MONSTER_ABSORB_CAP_ANCHOR
; XYDP-EXTENSION-END EQUIP_MONSTER_ABSORB_CAP
#IF
LARGE N$XY_MDA_CapBonus 25
#ACT
MOV N$XY_MDA_CapBonus 25
#IF
#ACT
INC N$XY_MDA_Cap <$STR(N$XY_MDA_CapBonus)>
MOV N$XY_MDA_Final <$STR(N$XY_MDA_Raw)>
#IF
LARGE N$XY_MDA_Final <$STR(N$XY_MDA_Cap)>
#ACT
MOV N$XY_MDA_Final <$STR(N$XY_MDA_Cap)>
#IF
EQUAL N$XY_MDA_Final 0
#ACT
StruckDamageAbsorb * 100 1 1
MOV N$XY_MDA_TimerActive 0
BREAK
#IF
LARGE N$XY_MDA_Final 0
#ACT
StruckDamageAbsorb * 100 <$STR(N$XY_MDA_Final)> 300
MOV N$XY_MDA_TimerActive 1
#IF
EQUAL N$XY_MDA_TimerLoop 0
#ACT
MOV N$XY_MDA_TimerLoop 1
DELAYGOTO 240 @XYDP_MonsterAbsorbTick
BREAK

[@XYDP_MonsterAbsorbTick]
#IF
EQUAL N$XY_MDA_TimerActive 1
#ACT
DELAYGOTO 1 @XYDP_RecalcMonsterAbsorb
DELAYGOTO 240 @XYDP_MonsterAbsorbTick
BREAK
#IF
EQUAL N$XY_MDA_TimerActive 0
#ACT
MOV N$XY_MDA_TimerLoop 0
BREAK
